title: Functional Spec
description: A functional spec (FUNC): a single business rule with acceptance criteria, extracted from the PRD.

title.description: One-line business description. Imperative, directive, no filler

description.description: Multi-paragraph narrative. What problem this solves, who is affected, what user-visible behaviour is expected. Technical implementation lives in plan.md, not here.

acceptance_criteria.description: Verifiable acceptance criteria. Each criteria starts with a commitment level.

implements.description: Optional. Concrete contract operation IDs the spec touches.

depends_on.description: Optional. Other FUNC spec IDs this spec depends on (cannot be implemented before they ship).

status.description: Optional. Lifecycle status. Omitting is equivalent to 'active'.
